justification: The most specific shared content is the use of schematic incised circles/discs together with bands of parallel lines, with both surfaces including some forms that may be read as highly stylized body or face-related imagery. The biggest difference is that A is organized as a multi-element narrative or glyphic panel with rows of signs and several small figures or creatures, while B is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic/mask-like form with paired eye-like circles and a central round feature.
